comment: 37yo female with PCOS meeting Rotterdam criteria (oligo-anovulation + clinical hyperandrogenism + polycystic ovarian morphology on TVUS) + comorbid obesity (BMI 33) + impaired fasting glucose. PCOS-associated endometrial cancer RR ~2.7 via chronic unopposed estrogen on anovulatory endometrium; obesity + insulin resistance multiplicative. Fires RF-REPRODUCTIVE-PCOS-ENDOMETRIAL-PREVENTION. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-REPRODUCTIVE-PCOS-ENDOMETRIAL-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (combined hormonal contraception OR cyclic progestin OR levonorgestrel IUD + weight management + metformin discussion); alternative = IND-REPRODUCTIVE-PCOS-ENDOMETRIAL-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (symptom-driven endometrial biopsy only).
